title: Fractional parts of powers of negative rationals
summary: We prove that for any real number $ξ\neq 0$ and any coprime integers $p>q\ge1$ such that $ξ$ is irrational or $q>1$, the image in $\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z}$ of the sequence $(ξ(-p/q)^n)_{n\ge 0}$ is not contained in any interval of length less than $(1+q/p-q^2/p^2)/p$.
